CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE store_master_india
(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    USUBJID VARCHAR(200),
    CMSEQ INT,
    CMTRT VARCHAR(200),
    CMDECOD VARCHAR(200),
    CMDOSE DOUBLE,
    CMDOSU VARCHAR(200),
    CMROUTE VARCHAR(200),
    CMSTDTC DATE,
    CMENDTC DATE,
    CMINDC VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS DATETIME,
    silver_load_ts DATETIME
)
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'clinicaltri-bronze/bronze/store_master_india.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsy01_file,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
);


-- drop EXTERNAL TABLE store_master_india

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE emp_info
(
department VARCHAR(200),
joining_date date,
salary INT,
bonus_amount int,
city VARCHAR(50)

)
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'clinicaltri-bronze/bronze/emprun1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsy01_file,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
);

select department,joining_date,salary,city,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION by department order by salary desc) rn from emp_info ;
